name: Sunburst2 Deluxe ECU (Lua Power)
author: Kristof
description: Deluxe ECU for the Hirochi Sunburst's 2.5L F4, built against the real stock jbeam: a Lua power multiplier, native rev-limiter/idle/damage tuning, an indestructible toggle, three VGT turbo stages with real turbo geometry, three real transaxle options (15-speed manual, 6-speed sequential, 8-speed auto), an optional big-block 6.2L torque-curve remap, an in-game tuning app, and backfire/BOV sound hooks.
